title: Q8
description:
“By faith Sarah herself also received strength to conceive seed, and she bore a child when she was past the age, because she judged Him faithful who had promised.”
Read: Gen 17:15–19, Gen 18:9–15, Gen 21:1–7
a) Sarah laughed, and Yahweh asked, “Is anything too hard for Yahweh?” What does that bring forward into faith in the One who promised?
